name: Exp_JBrainSig1_UltraRSI
summary: This EA combines two indicators — JBrainTrendSig1 and UltraRSI — to generate trading signals. It offers three operational modes: using JBrainSig1 as a filter for UltraRSI signals, using UltraRSI as a filter for JBrainSig1 signals, or a composition mode where either indicator's open signal paired with the other's close signal triggers a trade. Entry signals require cross-confirmation from both indicators before opening buy or sell positions.
summary_zh: 该EA结合JBrainTrendSig1和UltraRSI两个指标生成交易信号。提供三种运行模式：JBrainSig1过滤UltraRSI信号、UltraRSI过滤JBrainSig1信号、以及组合模式。入场信号需要两个指标的交叉确认后才会开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是双指标交叉确认系统，结合了趋势判断指标JBrainTrendSig1和动量振荡指标UltraRSI。入场条件根据Mode参数决定：在JBrainSig1Filter模式下，UltraRSI产生开仓信号但需JBrainSig1确认方向；在UltraRSIFilter模式下则相反；在Composition组合模式下，任一指标的开仓信号与另一指标的平仓信号组合即可触发入场。出场条件为两个指标同时发出平仓信号（SELL_Close1&&SELL_Close2或BUY_Close1&&BUY_Close2）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。每笔交易设有StopLoss和TakeProfit，分别为1000点和2000点，风险收益比为1:2。策略使用H4时间框架，属于中长期交易系统，依赖新K线检测机制避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's core strategy is a dual-indicator cross-confirmation system combining the trend-detection JBrainTrendSig1 indicator and the momentum oscillator UltraRSI. Entry conditions depend on the Mode parameter: in JBrainSig1Filter mode, UltraRSI generates open signals but JBrainSig1 must confirm direction; in UltraRSIFilter mode the roles are reversed; in Composition mode, either indicator's open signal paired with the other's close signal triggers entry. Exit conditions require both indicators to simultaneously emit close signals (SELL_Close1 && SELL_Close2 or BUY_Close1 && BUY_Close2). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Each trade includes StopLoss at 1000 points and TakeProfit at 2000 points, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe as a medium-to-long-term trading system, relying on a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trading within the same bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易份额或固定手数，负值为手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio or fixed lot; negative = fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：JBrainSig1过滤、UltraRSI过滤或组合
parameters.description_en: Entry algorithm mode: JBrainSig1 filter, UltraRSI filter, or combined

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 双指标交叉确认机制降低了假信号的概率，提高了入场质量
提供三种灵活的运行模式，适应不同市场环境
设有止损止盈，风险收益比为1:2，具有良好的风险控制基础
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓
支持多空方向独立控制，交易灵活性高
pros_en: Dual-indicator cross-confirmation reduces false signal probability and improves entry quality
Three flexible operational modes adapt to different market conditions
StopLoss and TakeProfit are configured with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, providing solid risk control
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated entries within the same bar
Independent buy/sell direction control offers high trading flexibility
cons: 组合模式下任一指标的开仓信号即可触发交易，可能导致入场条件过于宽松
JBrainTrendSig1使用循环回溯查找信号，在历史数据量大时可能影响性能
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在点差扩大或低流动性时段可能产生不利成交
止损1000点相对较大，在某些品种上可能承受较大浮亏
依赖自定义指标文件（JBrainTrend1Sig和UltraRSI），缺失任一将导致运行失败
cons_en: Composition mode allows either indicator's open signal to trigger a trade, potentially making entry conditions too loose
JBrainTrendSig1 uses a loop-back search for signals, which may impact performance with large historical data
No spread filter or trading session filter, risking unfavorable fills during wide spread or low liquidity periods
StopLoss of 1000 points is relatively large, potentially enduring significant floating drawdown on some instruments
Depends on custom indicator files (JBrainTrend1Sig and UltraRSI), missing either causes runtime failure
improvements: 添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在不利条件下开仓
将JBrainTrendSig1的信号循环回溯逻辑优化，限制最大回溯K线数量以防止性能问题
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Optimize the JBrainTrendSig1 signal loop-back logic by limiting the maximum number of bars to search, preventing performance issues

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不利成交
JBrainTrendSig1的循环回溯没有上限限制，极端情况下可能造成卡顿或超时
依赖外部自定义指标，指标文件缺失或版本不兼容会导致EA无法正常运行
risk_points_en: No spread filter — wide spreads during high volatility periods can lead to unfavorable fills
JBrainTrendSig1 loop-back has no upper limit — extreme cases may cause lag or timeout
Dependency on external custom indicators — missing or incompatible indicator files cause EA failure
